c1ec1d7e62365de7.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Regional BDR Team Manager to lead a full-time team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing new inbound and outbound sales development representative (SDR) teams, focusing on both pipeline generation and the professional development of team members. The position is integral to Canonical's expanding global sales and field engineering teams. Role Context and Objectives This role is designed for individuals who are organized, persistent, analytical, and committed to fostering the growth of smart and ambitious sales professionals. As a BDR Team Manager, you will contribute to Canonical's sales development organization, which functions as a sales academy, emphasizing skill development and culture building. The objective is to manage inbound leads for a global technology company while developing sales professionals with integrity, empathy, and a strong work ethic. Key Responsibilities Manage and mentor a team of 2-10 SDRs / BDRs. Maintain a multi-million dollar pipeline. Take an active interest in the development of team skills and the establishment of team culture. Ensure team members learn and develop the necessary skills to represent the company effectively. Experiment with new outbound approaches to adapt to market changes. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be determined to grow their own skills alongside those of their team and enjoy learning about new technologies. Canonical represents open source innovation, offering a growing range of solutions and opportunities for learning and specialization. Candidates should be open to innovation and adapting strategies to market dynamics. Our SDRs are typically outstanding graduates from STEM fields who are starting their sales career in the software industry. Work Environment Canonical operates as a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with over 1200 colleagues in more than 75 countries and limited office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times annually in various global locations for strategy and execution alignment. Most Canonical colleagues have worked remotely since the company's inception in 2004. This role offers an environment that encourages different thinking, smarter work, and continuous skill development. About Canonical Canonical is a technology firm focused on open source, known for publishing Ubuntu, a platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud. The company recruits globally and maintains high standards for its team members, expecting excellence in all areas of work. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination, valuing diversity of experience, perspectives, and background.

c1505066c33e3d55.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية والدعائية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للسوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها بشكل نهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المتخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد. ستتاح للموظف فرصة للمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجيات التسويق لمنتجات الشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال التسويق.

c102482f8c579f13.job_title: Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Metro/Rail Project
c102482f8c579f13.description: About Systra SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs safe and sustainable transport solutions globally, focusing on social inclusion and access to essential services. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to maintenance. SYSTRA operates in over 80 countries and generates 74% of its turnover internationally, supporting clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. Role Overview SYSTRA is seeking a Lead Operation and Maintenance (O&M) expert for a Metro/Rail Project in Riyadh. This full-time role involves acting as a subject matter expert in operation and maintenance for Automatic Metro Systems. The primary responsibility is to ensure the operability and maintainability of the transportation system, including all sub-systems and equipment provided by the Contractor, in compliance with contractual requirements throughout all project phases. The project aims to achieve the highest international standards for railway systems. Key Responsibilities Establish documentation review reports in a timely manner, adhering to project schedules and quality policies. Report on compliance and deviations during relevant design progress meetings. Maintain privacy in communications with various stakeholders. Organize workshops and meetings with contractors to identify gaps, facilitate solutions, and ensure submission timelines. Report to the Package Manager, System Manager, and Design Manager on pending issues and potential non-compliance. Issue weekly progress reports. Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and site tests, both locally and internationally. Act as an Operation and Maintenance expert on behalf of the Engineer to the Employer, as requested. Provide expert advice within the Engineer team regarding the operability and maintainability of various sub-systems (E&M, Signaling, Track, Civil work, Rolling stock, Communication, External stakeholders). Implement required reporting to generate relevant project information. Provide constraints to sub-systems. Communicate inputs clearly and in a controlled manner to relevant parties. Manage design changes and ensure they are communicated and adequately addressed by the Contractor. Ensure consistency of design produced by sub-systems. Verify compliance of sub-systems with allocated requirements and check traceability evidence between requirement definition and design compliance. Define appropriate actions and prepare technical requests and follow-ups. Translate operating requirements into specific criteria for sub-system management. Manage train operation during construction activities. Participate in Operational Site Tests (OST). Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in Operation and Maintenance, specifically within Metro/Rail projects. Demonstrated expertise in Automatic Metro Systems. Strong understanding of transportation system sub-systems and equipment. Ability to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and international railway standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a dynamic team focused on delivering high-standard public transport solutions.

Ensure satisfaction for both internal and external customers by addressing their needs courteously and promptly. Qualifications 1-2 years of relevant experience. c153b4a11f2e60b8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نجاة عايج سليمان الحجيلي لتعبئة المياه عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفساراتهم وتحديث بياناتهم. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التطبيق الفعال لسياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بحضور الموظفين وإجازاتهم، ومعالجة الشكاوى والاستفسارات بمهنية، وإعداد التقارير والوثائق اللازمة لدعم عمليات الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بمراقبة دوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب الالتزام بتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية في بيئة عمل منظمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

c1a52c2453372e35.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform recognized as a Great Place to Work®. Specializing in emerging markets, Unifonic leverages over 25 years of conversational AI research and development to serve more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company is also pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. This full-time role involves managing key accounts, understanding customer business objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through Unifonic's solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, develop strategic account plans, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success, retention, and revenue growth. The position requires 5-10 years of experience, emphasizing relationship management, strategic thinking, and commercial acumen to achieve business objectives and maximize long-term customer value. Identify opportunities for account expansion through additional products and services. Conduct regular business reviews and ensure customer satisfaction. Proven track record of managing enterprise customers and driving revenue growth. Strong business development and solution-selling capabilities. Demonstrated experience in executive stakeholder management and strategic account planning. Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Ability to identify growth opportunities, manage sales pipelines, and achieve commercial targets. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver customer success. Required Skills and Tools Proficiency in CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent. Strong forecasting and pipeline management skills. Data analysis and reporting to support account growth and business decisions. Strategic planning and account growth management. Proposal development and commercial documentation. Commercial acumen with the ability to develop customer-centric solutions. Customer relationship management (CRM) best practices, including customer retention and expansion strategies. Key Attributes Analytical thinking and problem-solving. Ownership and accountability. Effective communication across teams. Collaboration and teamwork. Adaptability and continuous learning. Mentorship and knowledge sharing. Resilience under pressure. Commitment to quality and attention to detail. Advocacy for best practices and innovation.

c1e8fb5bbfcb6f08.description: About the Role Echelon is seeking a Partner Portfolio Lead Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role reports to the Head of Partner Strategy and is responsible for leading the decision-making process regarding which partners are integrated into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. The role involves evaluating potential partners against key criteria and collaborating with various internal teams to finalize agreements. Key Responsibilities Lead the assessment of potential partners based on technology, industry, layer within the stack, and mutual fit, presenting recommendations to the leadership team. Collaborate with engineering leadership to evaluate candidates' architecture, maturity, security, and deployability, including required engineering effort. Validate industry demand, sectors, use cases, and accounts with account teams prior to commitment. Determine the partner's position in the technology stack and assess if that layer requires filling, strengthening, or should remain open. Evaluate strategic intent, commercial ambition, operational methods, and appetite for joint investment to ensure mutual commitment. Assess each new partner's addition relative to the company roadmap and existing partners, identifying gaps, overlaps, or competition to ensure a cohesive market offering. Recommend partnership models and negotiate terms, including go-to-market strategies, delivery, revenue share, exclusivity, liabilities, and exit clauses, with leadership, Legal, Finance, and business units. Develop partner profiles, assessment frameworks, recruitment processes, and the operating model for partner transitions in collaboration with leadership and Partner Sourcing and Intelligence. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience in assessing, structuring, and signing partnerships at a technology vendor, integrator, or in corporate development or consulting. Ability to engage engineers on architecture, integration, and deployment, and to discern robust technology from demonstrations. Deep understanding of how sectors acquire and utilize technology, with the ability to judge where value will be created. Experience in designing channel/partnership models and negotiating revenue share or terms with larger counterparties. Credibility with founders, engineers, Legal, and Finance, with the ability to assess how partners contribute to the overall portfolio. Strong communication skills to simplify complex systems and articulate the value of work. Comfortable progressing with partial data and in ambiguous environments. Ability to test claims against data and explain decisions. Advantageous Experience Experience within a technology vendor’s partner organization or a cloud provider’s ecosystem team. Exposure to venture investment, M&A, or joint ventures, including diligence and documentation. Depth of knowledge in sectors where Echelon operates, such as government, energy, financial services, and healthcare. Work Environment and Values This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with limited travel. Echelon values a customer-first approach, ownership mentality, clear communication, comfort with ambiguity, and a long-term building perspective. The company fosters an environment of curiosity, speed, rigor, confidence balanced with humility, autonomy, resourcefulness, and situational leadership. The use of AI tools for research, assessment, and negotiation is integral to the work process. Compensation The compensation package includes a base salary, housing, transport, and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Full terms will be shared at the offer stage.

c1efec8c0139729d.description: About My Clinic My Clinic is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia, established in 2017. The organization focuses on delivering healthcare services that promote longer, healthier, and happier lives, driven by principles of care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility. My Clinic is currently seeking an Information Security Manager to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Information Security Manager will lead My Clinic’s information and cybersecurity program, with a primary focus on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). This role is responsible for ensuring the protection of sensitive patient data and adherence to cybersecurity regulations, including CIS, NIST, and National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) controls and standards. The manager will develop and execute comprehensive security and risk management strategies, oversee the information security team, and collaborate with IT and business leadership to safeguard data while maintaining operational integrity. This is a full-time position requiring 7-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain information security and data protection policies, procedures, and guidelines in alignment with industry standards (*, CIS, NIST, NCA) and regulatory requirements, including KSA’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Lead enterprise-wide risk assessments to identify, analyze, and prioritize cybersecurity and data protection risks. Develop and maintain a risk register, implement risk mitigation strategies, and monitor risk treatment plans. Oversee outsourced Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to cybersecurity threats. Review KPIs, evaluate incident handling, and align SOC activities with security objectives. c168665a589b175e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن فرع شركة سوسيداد ايبيريكا دي كونستركشنز الكتريكاس سوسيداد ا عن توفر وظيفة مهندس كهربائي بدوام كامل في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دعم للمحطات الفرعية للطاقة الكهربائية الخاصة بالجر، والمعدات الكهربائية المرتبطة بها. التنسيق لضمان جاهزية وصيانة أنظمة تقنية المعلومات الداعمة لعمليات تشغيل وصيانة حافلات الترولي الكهربائية. تنسيق أنشطة إدارة الحركة المرورية المتعلقة بتشغيل حافلات الترولي الكهربائية، واستمرارية الخدمة، وكفاءة أداء المسارات. تنسيق أعمال الصيانة المتعلقة بخطوط التغذية الكهربائية العلوية (OCL)، والهياكل الداعمة لها، الكهربائية. مراقبة جاهزية حافلات الترولي الكهربائية، والعيوب الفنية بالمركبات، والأعطال، والأعطال المتكررة، وأداء أعمال الصيانة. تنسيق أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، والإصلاحات التصحيحية، والفحوصات الفنية، c1278f1ed53429c0.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operates across construction, manufacturing, and engineering services. The company is classified as a Grade I contractor by the Government of Saudi Arabia and specializes in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects within the Energy, Infrastructure, and Engineering Services sectors. Alfanar Construction focuses on Power and Water, Transmission and Distribution, Building Construction (Industrial & Commercial), and Electro-Mechanical projects. Role Overview Alfanar Projects is seeking a SR. ENGINEER, PLANNING to join their team in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves conducting critical path analyses, recommending mitigating actions, reviewing target budgets, and initiating monthly progress reports for project updates. The position requires 4-6 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop fully integrated Baseline EPC Level 3 schedules in Primavera P6 and Level 2 schedules for proposals. Perform monthly updates of Project Master Level 3 schedules and conduct Critical Path Analyses, recommending necessary mitigating actions. Produce progress and productivity curves, along with earned value reporting. Participate in regular project team reviews, Public Planning Meetings, and Last Planner Meetings. Prepare recovery schedules, revised baselines, and delay analyses, highlighting delays to the project control manager/project manager in advance. Support the project team in developing action plans to avoid/minimize cost/schedule overruns. Track budgets, highlight budget impacts to the project control manager, and update budgets in SAP. Review target budgets in conjunction with engineering, project, and construction management. Support the change control process, including establishing forms, logs, and expediting methods. Assist in risk register development and invoicing processes. Initiate daily discussions with project groups to assess change/schedule implications and estimate resources based on site productivity. Prepare project updates, monthly progress reports, schedule forecasts, and staffing histograms. Collect information and produce monthly Status Reports for Project Managers, issuing formal reports with project input. Initiate ad hoc progress reports for effective EPC controls and provide statistical data for management reviews. Role Accountabilities Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job and develop a career path plan. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within cost and time constraints. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve operational problems and escalate complex issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met, developing effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures within the defined work area. Work Location This position is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Ras Tannurah, Buqayq, Al Qatif, Safwa, Sayhat, Tarut, Al Hafuf, Al Mubarraz, Al Jafr, Umm Al Hamam, Inak, Darin, and Al Jish. Experience Required Candidates should possess 4-6 years of relevant experience for this full-time role.

c106049fc4b5d552.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز التواصل الناجح لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة عن أخصائي نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فهم السلوك البشري والتفاعلات النفسية، مع المساهمة في إعداد التقارير المتخصصة وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء البحوث في أوجه النشاط النفسي المشتركة بين الأفراد والكشف عن القوانين والمبادئ التي تفسر سلوك الفرد وتفاعله مع المنبهات المحيطة. دراسة جميع مظاهر الحياة النفسية من خلال تحليل جوانب السلوك المختلفة مثل الجانب الحركي، العقلي، الانفعالي، والاجتماعي. دراسة مبادئ التعلم لحالات التعلم الإنساني وأشكاله المتعددة. تنفيذ دراسات ميدانية لتطبيق اختبارات الذكاء والأداء بهدف قياس أنماط النمو العقلي والنفسي. دراسة المبادئ والقوانين العامة لاستخلاص الأسس المميزة للسلوك الإنساني. تحليل وتطوير الاتجاهات والقيم الاجتماعية بناءً على المعلومات المستنبطة من المراقبة والمتابعة أو البحوث والتجارب الميدانية. دراسة وتطوير النظريات والاستخدامات التطبيقية في مجال تعديل السلوك. دراسة الأسس البيولوجية للسلوك من خلال التعرف على أجزاء الجهاز العصبي وأثرها في السلوك. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بعلم النفس، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء البحوث والدراسات الميدانية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لفهم السلوك البشري وتفسيره. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد وكتابة التقارير المتخصصة. القدرة على عرض المعلومات وتوضيحها بشكل فعال. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في حفظ البيانات والوثائق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الأخصائي النفسي ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز التواصل الناجح لرعاية ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c165b4977204f875.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. التأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم جيد لعمليات تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: غير معلن.

c1699616ffe30b2a.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience to oversee, design, develop, and implement electrical systems for construction, industrial, or infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with technical specifications, safety standards, project schedules, and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Design, review, and supervise electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, low-current systems, and control systems. Prepare electrical drawings, technical specifications, and project documentation. Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and other engineering disciplines to ensure efficient project delivery. Monitor project execution and ensure compliance with approved designs, codes, and standards. Conduct site inspections and provide technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning phases. Evaluate contractor submittals, shop drawings, material requests, and technical proposals. Identify and resolve technical issues and implement effective engineering solutions. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations. Prepare project progress reports and provide recommendations for improvements. Support project planning, budgeting, and cost-control activities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering projects. Professional certification is an advantage. Strong knowledge of electrical design standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, ETAP, Revit, or equivalent. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under pressure. Required Skills Electrical Design & Engineering Project Management Technical Review & Analysis Quality Control & Assurance Risk Assessment & Mitigation Teamwork & Coordination Problem Solving Communication & Reporting Time Management Knowledge of International Electrical Codes & Standards Experience 7+ years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within real estate development.

c1bccd4ff66fdaa4.description: About the Role The National Medical Care Company (Care) is seeking a Medical Reports Clerk to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves processing requests for medical reports for Riyadh Care Hospital, ensuring compliance with hospital requirements and maintaining high standards of patient service and confidentiality. Key Responsibilities Respond to patient inquiries concerning medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves. Receive and process requests for medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves. Issue medical reports, translations, birth notifications, and sick leaves in accordance with established policies and procedures. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely preparation and delivery of patient reports. Complete and verify demographic patient information accurately. Provide support and assistance to patients with inquiries or complaints. Maintain an organized filing system for efficient document retrieval. Contribute to departmental objectives and operational efficiency, including processing large volumes of work. Ensure all organizational and departmental quality standards are met. Uphold strict confidentiality regarding patient information. Participate in quality improvement programs as directed. Foster positive relationships with peers, staff, and visitors. Perform additional work-related duties as assigned by the Department Head/Manager or within the scope of Health Information Management (HIM). Reporting Structure This position reports directly to the Medical Reports Supervisor, HIM Director, or Department Head. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on supporting the operations of Riyadh Care Hospital within the National Medical Care Company (Care).

c1339b3bacba0c21.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, committed to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. With 95,000 employees across more than 150 countries, the company focuses on developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of over 72 million patients annually. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the future of healthcare within a purpose-driven career. The Credit & Collections Function The Credit & Collections function supports Medtronic’s business operations in Saudi Arabia. This team is responsible for managing customer receivables, ensuring timely payments, resolving account discrepancies, and minimizing credit risk. The function collaborates closely with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance departments to maintain accurate accounts and facilitate efficient collections processes. Role Summary: Credit Collections Clerk III As a Credit Collections Clerk III, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, focusing on the follow-up of overdue payments and the reconciliation of balances. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and offers a flexible work arrangement. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field and involves working with various internal and external stakeholders to resolve payment barriers and maintain accurate account records, directly contributing to timely collections and reduced overdue receivables. Primary Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on overdue payments to support timely collections. Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, and credit notes. Coordinate with Sales, Customer Care, and Finance teams to resolve disputes and remove payment barriers. Monitor payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts or potential credit risks in line with company procedures. Maintain accurate records of collection activities, customer communications, and account status. Prepare accounts receivable updates, highlighting overdue balances, collection progress, and required follow-up actions. Required Experience 2-5 years of experience in credit collections or a related financial role. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a flexible work arrangement. The salary for this role is not disclosed.

c14343e60053f2ed.description: About the Role Khalid Ali Alturki & Sons Company (Alturki Holding) is seeking an Electrical Technician for Musanadah, their integrated Facilities Management services arm. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Electrical Technician will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems across client facilities, ensuring their safety, reliability, and compliance. Key Responsibilities Perform planned preventive maintenance on various electrical systems, including distribution boards, Motor Control Centers (MCCs), control panels, lighting, and power circuits. Diagnose and resolve electrical faults efficiently using standard test equipment to minimize system downtime. Maintain and test standby generators, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) units, and battery systems to ensure continuous backup power readiness. Install and terminate cables, wiring, and fittings in adherence to the Saudi Building Code and IEC standards. Respond to work orders within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and accurately log activities and defects within the Computer-Aided Facilities Management (CAFM) system, while consistently following permit-to-work and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in electrical systems installation, maintenance, and repair, preferably within a facilities management context. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, focusing on providing integrated Facilities Management services to clients through Musanadah.

c157ae18c409e250.description: About the Role Magrabi Health is seeking an Ophthalmic Technician to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting ophthalmologists and providing essential patient care within an eye care setting. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, as full training will be provided. Key Responsibilities Greet patients and accurately obtain their medical and ocular history. Perform preliminary tests, including visual acuity, color vision, depth perception, and visual field testing. Conduct tonometry and pupil dilation as directed by the ophthalmologist. Operate various ophthalmic equipment such as autorefractors, lensometers, slit lamps, and OCT machines. Perform and acquire ophthalmic ancillary diagnostic tests, including Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), corneal topography, fundus photography, and visual field analysis, ensuring image quality and proper documentation. Assist in refractive procedures, including pre- and post-operative assessments for LASIK, PRK, and other refractive surgeries; prepare patients, obtain measurements, and support the care team throughout the procedure workflow. Assist ophthalmologists during examinations and procedures. Maintain accurate patient records using EHR systems. Schedule appointments and support efficient patient flow within the clinic. Sanitize, calibrate, and troubleshoot clinical equipment on a regular basis. Coordinate with ophthalmologists regarding patients undergoing refractive procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Diploma of Optometry/Optics or an equivalent qualification. Valid Saudi MOH license as an optometry/optics technician. No prior clinical experience is necessary; full training will be provided. Strong interest in ophthalmology and eye care, with an eagerness to learn in a surgical center environment. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly and compassionately with patients. High attention to detail and the ability to follow clinical protocols accurately. Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume surgical setting. Basic computer literacy and willingness to learn EHR/EMR software. Professional demeanor, reliability, and a strong team-oriented attitude. Ability to stand for extended periods and assist with patient positioning as needed. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential opportunities in Jeddah. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c190605419a7ba57.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ماند وورلد عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يعمل المتدرب ضمن فريق المبيعات لتسويق وبيع منتجات الشركة من بطاقات الأعمال الرقمية وأجهزة NFC الذكية وحلول الهوية الرقمية للأفراد والشركات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين بشكل مستمر. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم منتجات وخدمات الشركة وشرح مزاياها. إعداد وتقديم عروض الأسعار ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع، تحرير الفواتير، تحصيل المبالغ، وتسليمها للإدارة المالية. متابعة العملاء بعد البيع لضمان رضاهم وتعزيز فرص البيع المتكرر. المشاركة في المعارض والفعاليات لتمثيل الشركة وجذب عملاء جدد. إعداد تقارير دورية عن المبيعات والزيارات ورفعها للإدارة. الخبرة المكتسبة يكتسب شاغل هذا الدور خبرة عملية في مجالات المبيعات المباشرة، المبيعات بين الشركات (B2B)، والتسويق الرقمي، مما يعزز من مهاراته المهنية في قطاع المبيعات. المؤهلات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع العملاء وتقديم العروض. الالتزام بإتمام عمليات البيع ومتابعة ما بعد البيع. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي في شركة ماند وورلد، في بيئة تركز على تحقيق الأهداف وتطوير المهارات في مجال المبيعات والتقنيات الرقمية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الموقع: مكة المكرمة الراتب: غير معلن

c1cb32290f4b4639.description: About Almarai Company Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is the number one FMCG Brand in MENA and a market leader across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. With over five decades of growth, Almarai has provided nutritious products under more than 20 brands, including Almarai, L’usine, and ALYOUM. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across its operations. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager Almarai is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time role is critical for maintaining company assets and ensuring operational availability across all departments. The Senior Engineering Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing a total preventative maintenance system to meet business requirements and standards. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain a total preventative maintenance system to ensure complete operational availability for all departments. Comply with agreed standards, budget, and provisions set by the business. Meet management performance targets established by the business. Ensure all plant and equipment are maintained in optimal condition at all times, adhering to standards and cost controls. Provide adequate skills, labor, and guidance across all departments to meet business operational needs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in engineering management. Proven ability to implement and manage preventative maintenance systems. Strong understanding of operational standards, budgeting, and performance target achievement. Experience in ensuring optimal condition of plant and equipment. Demonstrated capability in managing and developing technical teams. Benefits Almarai offers a competitive package for this role. Benefits include generous leave, medical coverage, a discretionary bonus, and opportunities for training and development. Location This position is based in the Makkah region, covering operations in Rabigh and Makkah.

c10776fa276b1d94.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities. About LIONS Riyadh LIONS Riyadh marks a bold new chapter for the world’s most prestigious platform for creative marketing. Launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, it is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community, home to the renowned Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry. Job Description The Head of Content will lead the creative and editorial vision for LIONS Riyadh, shaping the ideas, conversations, voices and experiences that define the Festival. This is not a traditional conference production role. The Head of Content will be a curator, storyteller, creative strategist and industry connector , someone with exceptional editorial judgement, deep curiosity and the ability to recognise the ideas and people capable of moving the industry forward. Responsible for the overall strategic direction of the entire content strategy. Working in close partnership with LIONS, the role will translate the global authority, creative standards and cultural relevance of the LIONS brand into a programme that feels unmistakably LIONS while being genuinely rooted in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. The successful candidate will build a content proposition capable of attracting the world's most influential CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands, creators, cultural voices and next-generation talent to Riyadh. They will create a Festival programme that goes beyond stages and panels connecting content, creativity, culture, learning, brand experiences, networking and extraordinary talent into one compelling Festival journey. Ensure the content team consistently delivers world-class, culturally relevant and commercially powerful content worthy of the LIONS brand. Key Responsibilities Lead the overall content strategy and direction for LIONS Riyadh, ensuring it reflects the LIONS brand, global standards and regional relevance. Develop and curate the overall programme across creativity, marketing, media, culture, technology and the future of the industry, including stages, talks, workshops, masterclasses and other Festival formats. Build and manage the speaker strategy, securing leading global and regional CMOs, creative leaders, brands, agencies, creators and cultural figures. Manage the content budget, including speaker costs, travel, moderators, producers and programme-related expenditure. Build strong relationships with local and international creative communities, industry leaders, advisory board members and strategic content partners. Lead and develop the content production team, including resourcing, scheduling, coaching, performance management and professional development. Work with Marketing and PR to use content, speakers and thought leadership to build audience demand and strengthen the Festival brand. Sponsorship direction and sales briefings to the wider team to ensure they understand the objectives and USPs when pitching to clients to secure deals. Work with Commercial and Partnerships teams to develop relevant branded-content opportunities without compromising editorial quality. Government liaison and technical aspects across all relevant projects. Work closely with Event, Marketing, Creative, Commercial and Operations teams to ensure content is fully integrated into the overall Festival experience. Work with department heads to develop year-round content strategies that increase audience engagement, commercial value and long-term impact. Overall team management, appropriate resourcing, coaching and mentorship of team members. KPI’s Timely delivery and quality of conference programmes. Strategy development and delivery. Quality and strength of the speaker line-up. Audience engagement and satisfaction across content sessions. Successful delivery of LIONS-aligned content and creative standards. Content contribution to PR, marketing and audience growth. Strength of relationships with key industry leaders, speakers and creative communities. Main Duties & Responsibilities: Own the content production timeline, ensuring key programme, speaker and delivery milestones are achieved on time. Manage the content budget effectively, ensuring strong value across speakers, agencies and content delivery. Monitor departmental performance, using financial, commercial and delivery data to track progress against agreed objectives and identify areas for improvement. Work closely with Commercial and Partnerships teams to identify relevant content opportunities while protecting editorial quality and the LIONS brand. Ensure content supports the wider commercial objectives of LIONS Riyadh, including audience growth, partnerships and ticket demand. People Management Mentor and provide any necessary training to the entire team and ensure all team members have the appropriate tools and methods to meet their required KPIs. Develop, communicate and manage the bonus structures and KPIs for all team members. Plan and allocate resources to effectively staff and accomplish the work to meet departmental productivity and quality goals. WPS/Mudad/SIF/GOSI) — 3+ yrs (mandatory) • Fast Formula authoring and debugging — 3+ yrs • HCM Extracts / BI Publisher — 4+ yrs • SQL / PL/SQL — 5+ yrs • Full HCM Implementations (end-to-end functional + technical) — 3+ full cycles Preferred Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, HR, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering • Experience in multi-country payroll implementations spanning US, India, and GCC (KSA/UAE), with additional APAC or EMEA exposure a plus • Strong understanding of payroll accounting — journal entries, reconciliation, accruals • Experience in HRMS/ERP migrations from SAP, PeopleSoft, ADP, Workday to Oracle Cloud • Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for third-party payroll integrations • Familiarity with WPS file formats and bank integration requirements specific to Saudi Arabia (Mudad) and UAE (SIF) • Understanding of GDPR, SOC2, and data privacy requirements for payroll data handling • Prior experience building or supporting WPS-compliant payroll extracts for Saudi Arabia and/or UAE in a live production environment

c1ba09421009b073.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for Customer Experience (CX) Intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
